recent.task: QPaint: Andres Sillet (3K, Russell Island) replied — not proceeding. Marked Lost. Atlas asked for reason. Weekly loss consolidation process established.

Wave 2 sent: 30 QPaint recovery emails. Pipeline: 37 contacted (8 cal + 30 wave), 1 replied (Nicholas), 119 remaining. 156/156 Pipedrive deals imported. Inclusion principle established — P3 deals reinstated.
QPaint: Joy Ryan replied (Day +1) — wants separate external/internal quotes for Warenda Close (7.5K). Atlas replied, Tas flagged. 2nd calibration reply.
Processed QPaint customer reply: Joy Ryan (Warenda Close) requests separate internal/external quotes. Positive Buying Signal. Flagged to James.
Email 4 (breakup): sent to 60 painters across CVC, PDV, Wave 1 campaigns. 60/60 reconciled. Pipeline → Campaign Complete.
Campaign Pulse: 60 painters at Email 3, Next Jul 29 (breakup wave). 2 conversions (Tas Moulis + Star Painters) from Travis Email 3. 5 days of silence since Jul 23. 24 Campaign Complete.

QPaint calibration: Nicholas Zappacosta (QBuild) replied positively to Logan Village email, then sent new government quote request for QAS Beenleigh. New opportunity generated from recovery conversation.
Site realigned: follow-up-first messaging, broadened language, two-path CTAs, health check section. Live at notforgotten.com.au
Repositioned homepage: quote follow-up → business intelligence. New hero, monthly insights report section, updated copy throughout. Live at notforgotten.com.au
First client payment received — Tas Moulis (QPAINT). Onboarding 9 paid, subscription Active at 99/mo MRR.
System check complete — Stale Prospect Alert fixed, quotes@ pipeline end-to-end verified. 2 clients active.
Star Painters Adelaide converted to client — Ahmad replied to Email 3 (Travis case study) with buying questions. Painter, SA.
Tas Moulis converted to client — called after Email 3 (Travis case study). Painter, Queensland. 11 opens over 10 days.

Email 3 sent: 74 prospects across CvC (38), PDV (18), Wave 1 trades (12), Wave 1 non-trades (6). Email 4 sent: 12 prospects (Next&Co, Click Click Media, Performance Cleaning, 9 Wave 1 Group 2). CRM touchpoints fixed (Email 2→Email 3 for 74 prospects). Sequence Status→Completed for 12 Email 4 completions.
CvC Day 7 checkpoint: 0 replies from 38 delivered (18 Control, 20 Treatment). Effective sample: 2 excluded (Distinct Painters — Unsubscribed Jul 13; SA Painter — Lost). Day 21 checkpoint due Aug 4.

Campaign pulse: 87 emails sent this morning (75 Email 2s + 12 Email 4 breakups). 0 replies across all active campaigns. CvC Day 6, PDV Day 6. CvC Day 7 checkpoint tomorrow. Email 3 due Jul 22 for 68 prospects.

Email 2 sent to 75 prospects across 3 campaigns: CvC (38), PDV (19), Wave 1 (18). Email 4 breakup sent to 12 prospects: Next&Co, Click Click Media, Group 2 Wave 1 (9), Performance Cleaning. Total: 87 emails reconciled.

Campaign Pulse: Executed Monday Email 2 prep — 75 drafts across 3 campaigns (CvC 38, PDV 19, Wave 1 New 18). Fixed 18 weekend dates, excluded 4 Lost/Unsubscribed, all batches pass Voice Review 8/8 + Technical Verification. Ready for Monday Jul 20 send.

Completed Wave 1 July 2026 Campaign Review (Group 2 — Mixed Industries). 10 prospects, 30 emails, 0 replies across all touchpoints. Full review saved to knowledge/campaign-reviews/wave-1-july-2026.md. Recommendation: pivot to painters-only for Wave 2, fix tracking tags before next send.
Prepare-ahead: drafted CvC Email 2 (29 painters), verified Wave 1 Email 2 (10/12 ready), fixed Distinct Painters unsubscribe, patched CCM/Next&Co CRM touchpoints
